name: TiddlyWiki5 stray angle bracket
injectionSelector: R:text.html - (comment.block, text.html meta.embedded, meta.tag, meta.filter.tiddlywiki5, meta.variable.macrocallinline.tiddlywiki5, meta.variable.macrocallblock.tiddlywiki5, markup.inline.raw)
comment:
An angle bracket standing where no construct opens. It carries a verdict in prose and stays clear of markup the parser consumes, so the exclusions name the regions that legitimately hold a `<` — a comment, an embedded language, a tag, a filter, a macro call, and raw markup.

R: puts it after every other injection, so a rule that claims the bracket keeps it.

This stands as a grammar of its own so one registration reaches every scope that colours wikitext. An injection written inside a grammar fires only where that grammar stands at the top, so a body wrapped by another grammar took no verdict at all while identical bytes in a `.tw` file took one.
